cleanContactTabs.note: Active/Inactive terminal KPI tabs include Week 0–Week 4 rows and weekly payment-only value/volume from Weekly Terminal Transactions. Product KPI tabs remain contact-only unless Collins requests metrics.

inactiveFollowUp.note: Separate detailed follow-up sheet retained for sorting by days inactive; KPI card link now opens the clean 3-column contact tab per Collins preference.

terminalKpis.method: Current week average from daily BRM report header snapshots; whole-number rounded.

definitions.formula: Total Terminals = Active Terminals + Inactive Terminals + Non-Transacting Terminals + Unassigned Terminals
definitions.active_terminals: Business terminals with payment value alone above ₦100,000 over a 7-day period; transfers excluded.
definitions.inactive_terminals: Business terminals with payment value alone below ₦100,000 over a 7-day period, excluding terminals classified as non-transacting; transfers excluded.
definitions.non_transacting_terminals: Businesses/terminals with no transaction for over 7 days.
definitions.unassigned_terminals: Total Terminal Count minus Terminals Assigned to BOs.
definitions.note: These four terminal buckets are treated as mutually exclusive so they add up to Total Terminals.

terminalDefinitions.formula: Total Terminals = Active Terminals + Inactive Terminals + Non-Transacting Terminals + Unassigned Terminals
terminalDefinitions.active_terminals: Business terminals with payment value alone above ₦100,000 over a 7-day period; transfers excluded.
terminalDefinitions.inactive_terminals: Business terminals with payment value alone below ₦100,000 over a 7-day period, excluding terminals classified as non-transacting; transfers excluded.

nonTransactingFollowUp.note: Sorted by longest duration without transaction first.

inactiveCleanSheet.definition: Inactive terminals list excludes non-transacting terminals and follows Collins terminal bucket formula.

terminalContactSorting.activeTerminals: KPI Clean Active Terminals now covers Week 0–Week 4. It uses each week-ending report’s Weekly Terminal Transactions section, business-level weekly PAYMENT value > ₦100k, transfers ignored, sorted within each week by total weekly payment volume descending.
terminalContactSorting.inactiveTerminals: KPI Clean Inactive Terminals now covers Week 0–Week 4. It uses each week-ending report’s Weekly Terminal Transactions section, business-level weekly PAYMENT value <= ₦100k with recent terminal use; non-transacting-only businesses excluded; transfers ignored; sorted within each week by total weekly payment volume descending.
terminalContactSorting.going_forward: Append/refresh each new week using the Weekly Terminal Transactions section only, not Daily Terminal Transactions.

dataAudit.headline: Dashboard is report-data driven. KPI cards show terminal-count buckets from Weekly Terminal Transactions + Non-Transacting section; click-through sheets show business-owner/business-name rows.
dataAudit.terminal_count_formula: Active (>₦100k payment) + Inactive (assigned <=₦100k payment minus non-transacting) + Non-Transacting + Unassigned = Total Terminals
dataAudit.why_counts_can_differ: One business owner can have more than one terminal, so Active Terminals may not equal Active Business Owner rows.
dataAudit.kpi_card_source: Weekly Terminal Transactions + Non-Transacting Terminals section from Moniepoint BRM reports; transfers excluded.
dataAudit.business_list_source: Weekly Terminal Transactions section aggregated to business-name/contact rows; one business can have multiple terminals.
